what: The code uses loose equality. JavaScript converts the values before comparing them, which can produce surprising results.

street.headline: You use `{2}`, but `{1}` dey safer
street.happen: `{2}` dey compare after e change the values. `{1}` compare the value and the type, so e no dey do magic conversion.
street.learn: `==` fit say `1` and `"1"` equal. `===` no go gree.

normal.headline: Use `{1}` instead of `{2}`
normal.happen: `{2}` converts the values before comparing them. `{1}` compares both the value and the type, so the result is easier to predict.
normal.learn: `==` fit say `1` and `"1"` equal. `===` no go gree.
